summary: Bedrock Office Billing Save Progress: creates billing_worksheet_drafts, one saved invoice worksheet per community + invoice type + service month (lines, removed one-offs, revision, saved_at/by, generated invoice link). Workpaper only; no invoice, line item, pending item or accounting row is touched.

preflight.name: invoices exists (002)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'invoices'

preflight.name: billing_worksheet_drafts does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'billing_worksheet_drafts'

expected_changes: Creates table billing_worksheet_drafts with UNIQUE (community_id, invoice_type, service_period), FKs to communities (cascade) and invoices (set null), CHECKs on type, period format, revision and jsonb arrays.
Grants SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE to service_role.
No existing row in any table is changed.

verify.name: one saved worksheet per community + type + month (unique constraint present)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'uq_billing_worksheet_draft' AND contype = 'u'

verify.name: service_role can read, insert and update
verify.sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN has_table_privilege('service_role', 'billing_worksheet_drafts', 'SELECT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'billing_worksheet_drafts', 'INSERT') AND has_table_privilege('service_role', 'billing_worksheet_drafts', 'UPDATE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int
